operator_io_quirks: All identifiers are mixed-case (City_ID, Official_Name, Host_city_ID); must be double-quoted in generated SQL.
DDL uses backtick-quoted FK refs (`city`(`City_ID`)) inside CREATE TABLE; sqlite_master text must be replayed verbatim.
Tiny tables: city=5, farm=8, farm_competition=6, competition_record=12 rows; original_values fully captured, no sampling needed.
competition_record has composite PK (Competition_ID, Farm_ID) -> composite-PK member max_l0=30 path.
farm_competition.Host_city_ID FK -> city.City_ID (parent exists, unique PK); competition_record FKs -> farm_competition and farm (both exist).
All columns notnull=0, null_rate=0.0; no CHECK/UNIQUE constraints in DDL.
Declared types: INT (dispatch Number, is_int), REAL (Number, float), TEXT (String). No date/time/bool/bit/year types.
Year columns are INT (1927..1931, 2003..2013) -> Number fuzzer, NOT Date; text-stored years absent.
Census_Ranking is TEXT with values like '636 of 5008' and '1442 of 5,008' (comma variant) -> String fuzzer, int-like substrings trigger +-1 neighbors.
Status TEXT with 2 distinct values (Town/Village) -> String fuzzer will not preserve the 2-value domain.
Area_km_2/Population REAL with small magnitudes (2.24..18.06, 351..5706) -> Number scale=4 range [-10^4,10^4] far wider than data.
Farm_ID values 1..8 but competition_record.Farm_ID samples show 2,3,8,1,4 (7 distinct) -> FK child draws from parent's final filtered column.
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on all INT/REAL columns: uniform in [-10^4,10^4] (scale=4) then +-1/+-2 (int) or +-0.01/+-0.02 (float) perturbation.
String fuzzer on TEXT columns: random a-zA-Z 0-9() strings length 0..20, plus 0.5 contaminate (suffix/prefix/drop char).
Year columns get Number fuzzer -> implausible years (e.g. -5000, 9999) -> FN on 'Year = 1927' style gold queries.
Status (2 values) and Theme/Hosts (free text) get random strings -> gold queries filtering Status='Town' likely FN.
Census_Ranking 'N of M' format not preserved -> FORMAT-sensitive gold queries FN.
FK Host_city_ID drawn from city.City_ID final values (5 rows) -> consistent; competition_record composite PK dedup keeps first occurrence.
Small table sizes (choose_table_sizes: level0=1+30u, x4 per level, cap 2500) -> city/farm tiny, competition_record larger; ties/duplicates rare.
Number fuzzer list_max quirk (overwrites max(el)+1 with full-range max) -> fresh draws dominate, original values rarely reused.
p=0.2 default, whole-instance p=0 w.p. 0.3 -> some instances pure-fresh (no original values), some mix.
max_l0 cap (rng*30) on non-PK columns -> repeated fresh values -> accidental ties/duplicates possible -> FP on DISTINCT/COUNT queries.
Composite PK (Competition_ID,Farm_ID) max_l0=30 -> repeated pairs dropped by sample_fresh_primary_keys, but individual columns may repeat.
Empty parent (if city filtered to 0) -> FK child gets NULLs; here city has 5 rows so unlikely.
